name: Swift Shots (Combat)
body:
You are exceptionally quick with your bow.

Prerequisite(s): base attack bonus +4, proficient with any bow

Benefit(s): When wielding a bow with which you are proficient, as a standard action you may make two attacks at your highest base attack bonus. Each of these attacks suffers a -2 penalty on the attack and damage roll.
